localizations.description:
After a lecture, your photo library can be left with dozens or even hundreds of slide photos: too useful to delete, rarely revisited, and awkward to hand directly to AI.

Lecture Asset turns those scattered photos into a clean, reusable lecture archive.

• Select up to 200 photos at once, with press-and-drag for faster selection
• Organize them by capture time and review the batch before processing
• Recognize Chinese and English text on device
• Generate a PDF for reading and saving
• Generate an AI-friendly ZIP containing high-resolution JPEGs, page order, and an OCR index
• After export, choose whether to delete the source photos or only clear the app’s working files

Processing and OCR stay on your device. No account is required, and there are no ads or analytics SDKs.

Lecture Asset does not generate AI summaries itself. It prepares your lecture photos as open, structured material that is easier to save, review, and pass to AI tools.

OCR is mainly for search and navigation. For formulas, tables, numbers, and fine details, refer to the original page images.

For Live Photos, Lecture Asset uses the still image only; motion and audio are not included.
